output.summary: Virginia spiderwort is a clump-forming herbaceous perennial native to the eastern and central United States, Ontario and Cuba. It spreads through underground stems into large colonies, bearing short-lived pink, white, blue or purple flowers daily for several weeks.
output.edibilityNote: Cherokee people historically mixed young leaves with other greens and ate them raw or boiled; leaves and sap may cause mild mouth and stomach irritation.
